subject: Request: Replenish lapsed sandbox credits — one-time safety net
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma@greenstack.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 9 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial expired — request for temporary credits to finish evaluation

Hi Laura,

Quick note — our sandbox (Trial ID: GSA-2026-07-12) exhausted its credits yesterday after a delayed procurement review on our side. We were in the middle of validating latency and end-to-end cost for an integration with our analytics pipeline and don’t have enough runway to finish the last set of tests before next-week leadership review.

Is there any chance Redwood can provide a one-time top-up (2,000 token-equivalent or similar) or a short-term extension so we can complete two final checkpoints? If helpful I can share exact prompts and expected token volumes. We’re close to an internal sign-off but need the data to compare against competing vendors.

Appreciate any flexibility — we’re evaluating Redwood for a company-wide rollout and would prefer to finish the run rather than restart.

Thanks,
Emma Li
Head of Integrations, Greenstack Analytics
emma@greenstack.ai

——
Attachments: none
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Emma Li <emma@greenstack.ai>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 9 Aug 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial expired — request for temporary credits to finish evaluation

Thanks for the note, Emma — I’m sorry the procurement timing impacted your run.

Can you confirm the trial ID and the two final checkpoints you need completed (latency profile and cost-per-token tests, or anything else)? If you can paste expected token counts for the tests that helps us size the top-up.

I’m looping in Monica (your AE) to coordinate an approval path. We have a one-time "safety-net" policy we can apply in cases like this — it typically covers small top-ups (1–5k tokens) valid for 30 days while you finish an evaluation. Final approval is needed from my manager; Monica will outline the ask and next steps.

I’ll also flag this in the HubSpot deal so we have the commit context.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Laura / Emma —

Thanks for the context. Emma, appreciate the transparency — sounds like you’re at the finish line. Proposed path from AE side: we can offer a one-time "safety-net recharge" of 2,000 token-equivalent credits, valid for 30 days, contingent on two simple commitments so we can measure ROI:

- Run the latency profile test with the shared prompt set (we’ll provide the script).
- Complete cost-per-token comparison and share the output CSV with us (we’ll validate totals).

If you confirm those, I’ll request manager sign-off. We’ll also ask that Greenstack adds a short email confirmation (or PO) accepting the top-up terms, which helps us log the concession.

Ben — looping you for approval on this one-off safety-net. The account is a mid-market prospect, likely to convert once these last checks land. Deal: GSA-8731.

Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Ben Carter

Emma — good news. Ben has approved a one-time safety-net recharge for Greenstack. Details below and next steps.

- Credit amount: 2,000 token-equivalent (code: GSA-SN-2000)
- Applies to: Trial ID GSA-2026-07-12 only
- Expiry: 30 days from issuance (2026-09-10)
- Conditions: complete the two evaluation checkpoints (latency script + cost CSV) and upload results to the HubSpot deal.

Attached: safety-net-approval-note.txt (internal authorization summary). Operations will apply the code today and confirm by email once it’s live. Please reply to confirm you accept these conditions (email confirmation is enough) and paste the expected token counts for the two runs so we can track usage.

If you want, we can schedule a 20-minute check-in next Wednesday to go through the latency script and make sure the prompts are tuned.

Thanks — looking forward to seeing the results.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
